description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for the centered nonuniform first-derivative rule central_D1_nonuniform_zero_grad_bc driven by problems/advection_1d_nonuniform_zero_grad.esm on the quadratic-stretch mesh (b=0.4). The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding of N (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4); the consumer re-derives the x-shaped geometry observed xc from N at each resolution. The forced-steady manufactured solution cos(pi x) has zero wall gradient (one-sided zero-gradient-family closure compatible) and source S(x) = c g'(x), so the recorded errors at t=0.1 are pure spatial-discretization error. The gate checks the L2 norm ONLY: the centered nonuniform operator with second-order one-sided walls is second-order in L2 by supraconvergence even though the pointwise truncation is O(h) where the spacing varies (LeVeque 2007 section 2.13); the pure-advection operator's constant null mode drifts secularly at the same second order, so the fixed-time-t=0.1 L2 error is a clean second-order snapshot.
